title: Code for: Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling
description: Reproducible code, published-data records, figures and manuscript sources for Mechanistic equivalence and measurement design in models of bacterial nitrogen signaling. Version 1.3.2 clarifies which GlnD constraints are jointly relaxed in a fit comparison, distinguishes the GlnE benchmark nuisance range from the earlier analytic illustration, and corrects the Fig5C input reference. It retains the observation-conditioned cascade bound, finite-depletion binding benchmark and earlier verification fixes. The fitted predictions and figures are unchanged. No new experimental measurements were generated. Native-assay applications remain conditional on the stated observation, biochemical and calibration assumptions. Original code is MIT licensed; the retained Gosztolai et al. workbook and model retain their CC BY 4.0 attribution. Primary literature PDFs are not redistributed.
